prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production directional animation sprite sheet for TERMINL Mall Rat. Reference is canonical identity margin-call-max; preserve EXACT character identity, outfit, footwear, hairstyle, colors, rich gritty illustrated pixel-art quality. This replaces a backwards-facing skating animation. Body-only sprites: skateboard is rendered separately in 3D, so NO SKATEBOARD OR WHEELS in any frame. No phones, receipts or carried luggage. FULL BODY INCLUDING BOTH FEET. TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, absolutely no backdrop, floor or shadows.
PRECISE 3-column by 4-row grid, 1536x2048 portrait sheet, twelve equal square cells, at least 40px clear transparent padding on every edge of every cell. No touching or crossing grid boundaries. All sprites use identical anatomical scale, crisp dark outline, rich detailed shading, NOT tiny flat vector people.
Camera is elevated 20 degrees. First NINE frames are REAR CHASE-CAMERA VIEW: camera BEHIND the rider; see BACK of head, BACK of shirt/jacket, heels, not chest or face. Rider travels AWAY from viewer toward TOP of image, board's imaginary nose points straight up image. Skating stance knees bent, feet offset front/back along that imaginary board. Preserve recognizable hair and clothing from rear; no mirrored shirt text on back.
Read in row-major order:
Row1 cell1: rear relaxed coast, both feet planted on imaginary board; cell2: rear pushing contact, right foot reaching down beside board; cell3: rear full push, right leg extends backward TOWARD camera, left foot stays forward.
Row2 cell1: rear recovering push, right knee lifts to return foot to board; cell2: rear deep crouch preload/landing compression; cell3: rear rising ollie, legs bent, knees rising.
Row3 cell1: rear kickflip tuck, both knees drawn upward, feet separated above imaginary spinning board; cell2: rear grab tuck, one hand reaches downward to imaginary board; cell3: rear grind balance pose, arms wide, knees flexed.
Row4 cell1: LEFT SIDE PROFILE coast, travel LEFT, body and face oriented left, both feet planted; cell2: FRONT view coast, travel TOWARD viewer, familiar face visible; cell3: RIGHT SIDE PROFILE coast, travel RIGHT.
The first nine rear views are essential: these must show the rider's BACK, not a front-facing portrait. Professional coherent skateboard animation key poses, preserve the degen identity. Actual transparency. No labels, no frame borders.
